description: One line as the STATEMENT prints it, kept beside the anchor it belongs to. This is not a second copy of a Bank Transaction — it is the other party's record of the same week, and the only thing that can say a transaction the feed never returned exists at all.

fields.description: The Bank Transaction this line turned out to be, once something matched them. Read-only and written by rebuild_anchor_chain; list_unmatched_statement_lines works the match out afresh and writes nothing. A line with nothing here is a line the feed never delivered, which is exactly the list worth reading.
